team.title: Leadership
team.subtitle: Meet the founder
team.name: Jenny Liu
team.bio: A graduate of USC and UCLA, Jenny spent years in Hollywood as a First Assistant Director, working on documentaries, feature films, and commercials. In 2023, she founded Summer Grace Studio in Silicon Valley to serve local tech companies and communities. In 2026, the studio rebranded as Good Film AI — harnessing Generative AI and AI Agents to empower film production. Use AI well, make films great.

trae_page.title: Trae SOLO — GA Release
trae_page.subtitle: Case Study
trae_page.intro: A 3-part cinematic video series produced for the global launch of Trae SOLO, ByteDance's AI-native coding assistant. From concept to delivery, Good Film AI crafted a launch campaign that bridges developer culture with cinematic storytelling.
trae_page.role: Full Production — Concept, Direction, Cinematography, Edit, Post
trae_page.launch_desc: Hero film for the global GA release. Sets the tone for Trae SOLO's entry into the developer ecosystem.
trae_page.vision_desc: Brand film exploring how Trae SOLO redefines the developer experience with AI-native workflows.
trae_page.community_desc: Documentary-style film capturing the developer community's reaction and early adoption stories.

tether_page.title: TetherIA — Aero Hand
tether_page.subtitle: Case Study
tether_page.intro: A product demo video produced for TetherIA's early-stage fundraising, showcasing the Aero Hand — an open-source, tendon-driven robotic hand with 7 active degrees of freedom, built for embodied AI research.
tether_page.role: Full Production — Concept, Direction, Cinematography, Edit
tether_page.video_desc: A cinematic product demo capturing the precision and capability of TetherIA's Aero Hand robotic system, designed to support their seed-stage fundraising efforts.
tether_page.about_desc: TetherIA develops the Aero Hand, an advanced robotic hand designed for embodied AI research. Their open-source platform features a tendon-driven mechanism with 16 joints, making sophisticated robotic manipulation accessible to researchers worldwide.

kah_page.title: Kids Against Hunger — Packing for LA
kah_page.subtitle: Case Study
kah_page.intro: An event film documenting Kids Against Hunger's extraordinary volunteer effort — packing 72,360 meals in just two days to support LA fire victims in January 2025.
kah_page.video_heading: Packing for LA Fire Victims — January 2025
kah_page.video_desc: A powerful event film capturing hundreds of Kids Against Hunger volunteers packing 72,360 meals in just two days to support communities displaced by the January 2025 LA fires.
kah_page.description: When the LA fires displaced thousands in January 2025, Kids Against Hunger mobilized hundreds of volunteers to pack meals for those in need. Good Film AI documented this powerful community response, capturing the energy, compassion, and determination of every volunteer who showed up. The resulting 228,096 meals were delivered to LA neighbors with the help of Convoy of Hope.
kah_page.about_desc: Kids Against Hunger is a community organization that mobilizes volunteers for large-scale humanitarian efforts in the San Francisco Bay Area and beyond.

festival_page.title: Tyrannus AI Film Festival
festival_page.subtitle: Co-Founded by Good Film AI
festival_page.intro: Good Film AI is a co-founder of the Tyrannus AI Film Festival and the Tyrannus Angel Awards — an international film movement uniting literary excellence, AI technology, and faith culture. Together with the Tyrannus Filmmakers Academy, we are building a platform where buried good stories are resurrected through the power of AI filmmaking.
festival_page.story_desc: As co-founders, Good Film AI brings its Silicon Valley filmmaking expertise and AI production capabilities to the Tyrannus Angel Awards. We are helping shape the festival's vision — bridging Eastern cultural depth with Western cinematic language to create a new cross-cultural audiovisual movement.
festival_page.story_desc2: The Tyrannus Angel Awards recognizes three categories — Original Works, Adapted Works, and Animated Works — each awarding Best Screenplay, Best Production, and Best Director, for a total of nine awards. The festival aims to prove that emotionally resonant, life-affirming content can achieve mainstream commercial success through AI-powered production.
festival_page.highlight1_desc: Three categories — Original, Adapted, and Animated — each with Best Screenplay, Best Production, and Best Director awards.
festival_page.highlight2_desc: Leveraging tools like Runway, Sora, Kling, and MidJourney so every storyteller can produce cinema-quality work.
festival_page.highlight3_desc: Simultaneous live broadcast across the Americas, Asia, and Africa with 150,000+ projected viewers.
festival_page.cta_desc: Visit the official Tyrannus Angel Awards website for submission guidelines, categories, and more.
